JVNDB-2026-000115
Sakura Editor vulnerable to OS command injection
Overview
Sakura Editor provided by Sakura Editor Development Community has a functionality "Open Terminal".
It does not neutralize the string which represents the current directory (the directory where the editing file is located).
OS command injection (CWE-78) - CVE-2026-59561

Affected Products
Sakura Editor Organization
SAKURA Editor versions prior to v2.4.3
Impact
If a victim user is directed to edit a file in a crafted directory, arbitrary OS command may be executed on the user's PC when the user invokes "Open Terminal".
Solution
[Update the Software]
Update the software to the latest version according to the information provided by the developer.
